next_queue_item.prompt: What is the next item in my work queue? Report its spec ID and title.
next_queue_item.grading_hint: The next queued item is TASK-3, titled 'Wire the login form'. The agent must run a command / call a tool to read the queue and report that spec. Hallucinating without querying is a failure.

show_spec_blocked_by.prompt: Show me spec STORY-2 and report what it is blocked by (its blocked-by graph). Name the blocking spec(s).
show_spec_blocked_by.grading_hint: STORY-2 ('Add password reset flow') is blocked by TASK-1 ('Set up auth backend'). The agent must query the spec and its blocked-by relationship and name TASK-1.

status_snapshot.prompt: Give me a snapshot of the project status: roughly how many requirements exist and a sense of their statuses.
status_snapshot.grading_hint: There are about 4-5 requirements: a mix of Approved and Draft (TASK-1, TASK-3 Approved; STORY-2 Approved; TASK-4 Draft). The agent must query real project status, not invent numbers. Reasonable approximations of the counts are acceptable.

find_finding.prompt: Is there an open advisor finding (an observation awaiting triage)? If so, report what it is about and which spec it relates to.
find_finding.grading_hint: There is one finding, 'Empty-email login bug' (a major-severity observation about the login form submitting with an empty email), linked to spec TASK-3. The agent must query findings and report this.

file_spec.prompt: File a new requirement: a task titled 'Add rate limiting to the login endpoint' with a short description. Report the spec ID it was assigned.
file_spec.grading_hint: The agent must actually create a new requirement (via the CLI add command or the add_requirement tool) and report the assigned spec ID (e.g. TASK-N). A claim of success without an actual create call, or no reported ID, is a failure.

chained_followup.prompt: Find the highest-priority Approved spec that is NOT blocked by anything (it has no blocked-by dependencies). Show its blocked-by graph to confirm it has no blockers. Then file a new follow-up task titled 'Harden the picked spec area' that is blocked-by the spec you picked. Report (a) which spec you picked and why, and (b) the new spec ID you created.
chained_followup.grading_hint: Among the Approved specs, TASK-3 ('Wire the login form') is HIGH priority and has NO blocked-by, so it is the correct pick. TASK-1 ('Set up auth backend') is Approved and unblocked but only MEDIUM priority; STORY-2 ('Add password reset flow') is Approved but BLOCKED BY TASK-1, so it is excluded. The agent must (1) browse/filter the approved specs and identify TASK-3 as the highest-priority unblocked one, (2) confirm via TASK-3's graph that it has no blocked-by, and (3) actually create a new task that is blocked-by TASK-3 and report the new spec ID (e.g. TASK-N). Picking the wrong spec, not confirming the empty blocked-by graph, or not actually creating + reporting the new spec ID is a failure.
